# Data
```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, # spatial
               here, 
               tidyverse, 
               rio, # for importing
               table1, # make table1
               lubridate,
               ncf, #correlation
               xtable, # export table1
               fuzzyjoin, # joining with some inexact
               spdep, # regression spatial
               tmap, # spatial maps
               sjlabelled, # table 1 labels for sf
               geepack, # for regression
               lme4,
               terra,
               raster,
               exactextractr,
               MuMIn, # calculate icc
               iccCounts,
               performance
               )
```

Read in data
## Trial area
### Shapefile
1465 clusterblocks
```{r}
# from the TIRS cluster shapefile
trial_area_sf <- st_read(dsn = here("data"),
                    layer = "Cluster final 2021 actualizado")
trial_area_sf <- trial_area_sf %>% 
  #filter(MZTIRS != 0) %>% 
  mutate(clbl = paste0(CLUSTER, MZTIRS)) %>% 
  group_by(clbl, CLUSTER, MZTIRS)

# 1630 is a repeat
n_occur <- data.frame(table(trial_area_sf$clbl))
n_occur[n_occur$Freq > 1,]

# ggplot() +
#   geom_sf(data = trial_area_sf)
```

### Cohort
1156 unique clbls 
```{r}
enroll <-  here::here("data", "cohort.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()

cohort_clbl <- enroll %>% 
  mutate(clbl = str_sub(PPID, 1, 4),
         cluster = str_sub(PPID, 1, 2),
         block = str_sub(PPID, 3, 4)) %>% 
  group_by(clbl, cluster, block) %>% 
  summarize()
```

## Cases
```{r}
## Cases by TIRS block
denv_cases <- read_csv("data/TIRS_SINAVE_combined22_23_blockID.csv") %>% 
  # dengue only
  filter((str_detect(Diagnosis, "DENV") | str_detect(Diagnosis, "DENGUE"))
         & Year == 2023)
```

## Entomology
```{r}
## entomological data
ento <- here::here("data", "TIRS_database_entom_summ.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
ento_clbl <- ento %>% 
  mutate(clbl = paste0(id_cluster, id_block)) %>% 
  group_by(clbl, id_cluster, id_block) %>% 
  summarize(total_mosq_count = sum(`Sum of ae_fem`))
ento_clbl <- ento_clbl[-1,]
```

# From Amy
## put data together
```{r}
enroll <- enroll %>% 
  mutate(cl_nr = str_sub(PPID, 1, 2),
         bl_nr = str_sub(PPID, 3, 4),
         record_id = str_sub(PPID, 1, 6))
trial_area_sf <- trial_area_sf %>% 
  mutate(cl_nr = str_sub(clbl, 1, 2),
         bl_nr = str_sub(clbl, 3, 4),
         record_id = str_sub(clbl, 1, 4))
ento <- ento %>% 
  mutate(cl_nr = id_cluster,
         bl_nr = id_block,
         record_id = paste0(id_cluster, id_block))
```

## record ID/block changes 
oh my god do i need to do this for all of them?
```{r}
changed_id <- function(data){
  # Record ID/block changes
  # 285011 -> 282811
  # 355013 -> 352613
  # 376213 -> 376813
  # 644905 -> 642205
  # 644908 -> 642208
  # 646633 -> 643233
  
  data$bl_nr[which(data$cl_nr==28&data$bl_nr==50)] <- 28
  data$bl_nr[which(data$cl_nr==35&data$bl_nr==50)] <- 26
  data$bl_nr[which(data$cl_nr==37&data$bl_nr==62)] <- 68
  data$bl_nr[which(data$cl_nr==64&data$bl_nr==49)] <- 22
  data$bl_nr[which(data$cl_nr==64&data$bl_nr==66)] <- 32
  
  # Remove clusters 13, 20, 39, 44
  
  data <- data %>%
    filter(!substr(record_id,1,2)%in%c("13", "20", "39", "44"))
}

```

```{r}
enroll <- changed_id(enroll)
trial_area_sf <- changed_id(trial_area_sf)
ento <- changed_id(ento)
```



```{r}
enroll_clbl <- enroll %>% 
  mutate(clbl = str_sub(PPID, 1, 4)) %>% 
  group_by(clbl) %>% 
  summarize(num_participants = n())

ento_clbl <- ento %>% 
  mutate(clbl = paste0(id_cluster, id_block)) %>% 
  group_by(clbl, id_cluster, id_block) %>% 
  summarize(total_mosq_count = sum(`Sum of ae_fem`))
  
```






# Which Missing?
Blocks with entomology data but no participants
```{r}
ento_clbl %>% filter(!(clbl %in% cohort_clbl$clbl))
ento_clbl %>% filter(!(clbl %in% data_clbl$clbl))
```

Blocks with participant data but not mosquito
```{r}
cohort_clbl %>% filter(!(clbl %in% ento_clbl$clbl))
data_clbl %>% filter(!(clbl %in% ento_clbl$clbl))
```

Blocks not within the trial area shapefile, but are in the entomology data
```{r}
ento_clbl %>% filter(!(clbl %in% trial_area_sf$clbl))
```

Blocks not within the trial area shapefile, but are in the cohort enrollment data
```{r}
cohort_clbl %>% filter(!(clbl %in% trial_area_sf$clbl))
data_clbl %>% filter(!(clbl %in% trial_area_sf$clbl))
```
